sources.fullCitation: Ilja Livschakoff Tanz-Orchester, with German refrain vocal by L. Monosson. “Süße Mamsell, denkst du noch an das kleine Hotel.” Tango; words by Fritz Rotter; music by Bronisław Kaper. Grammophon B 51043, Bestell-Nr. 23179, side 2, n.d. [not before 1930]. Label visible via Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv online upload.
sources.title: Süße Mamsell, denkst du noch an das kleine Hotel — Grammophon B 51043
sources.creator: Ilja Livschakoff Tanz-Orchester; L. Monosson, vocal refrain

sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, refrain sung by Leo Moll. “Spiel’ mir auf der Balalaika einen russischen Tango.” Electrola E.G. 2392, matrix 00499-1; recorded in Berlin, 18 August 1931, released October 1931; also issued as His Master’s Voice AM 3741. Session and issue data from the Electrola label list at musiktiteldb.de, based on the Discographie der deutschen Tanzmusik. Digital transfer on YouTube, video Oq4sWv9khw4.
sources.title: Electrola E.G. 2392
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester; Leo Moll, vocal refrain
sources.researchNote: The transfer description dates the recording to 1932, whereas the Electrola label list gives a Berlin session on 18 August 1931 and an October 1931 release. The session-based chronology is preferred.

sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, refrain credited as Leo Moll. “Signorina aus Brioni.” Tango; label credits Fritz Rotter and Dr. Kaper for music and text. Electrola E.G. 2400, n.d. Shellac disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube.
sources.title: Signorina aus Brioni — Electrola E.G. 2400
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Refrain: Leo Moll
sources.researchNote: The uploader identifies the singer credited as Leo Moll as Leo Monosson, gives 1931 as the issue year and accompanies the transfer with a 1930 photograph of Brioni. These details are not printed on the filmed label.

sources.shortCitation: Signed photographic postcard of Leo Monosson, Photo C. Wolf, Berlin
sources.fullCitation: Signed photographic postcard of the singer Leo Monosson, printed credit “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin”, with his name printed below the image and an autograph across it; undated. Reproduced on Cabaret Berlin, page for Leo Monosson.
sources.title: Leo Monosson — signed photographic postcard, Photo C. Wolf, Berlin
sources.creator: C. Wolf, Berlin

media.title: Leo Monosson — signed photographic postcard, Photo C. Wolf, Berlin
media.description: Leo Monosson on a signed photographic postcard, credited in print to “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” and captioned with his name. He sang the refrains on the Grammophon and Electrola recordings of two Kaper songs.
media.altText: Photographic postcard portrait of the singer Leo Monosson in a dark suit, signed across the lower edge.
media.publicCaption: Leo Monosson on a signed photographic postcard, credited in print to “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” and captioned with his name. He sang the refrains on the Grammophon and Electrola recordings of two Kaper songs.
media.publicCreditLine: Photo C. Wolf, Berlin; reproduced by Cabaret Berlin.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The postcard carries the printed credit “Photo C. Wolf, Berlin” but no date, and nothing is known of the photographer’s death, so no term can be computed and the photograph is treated as protected. The image is displayed at 424 × 611 px, the resolution published by the source, for scholarly identification of a documented performer of Kaper’s songs.
